confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bucharest price levels; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and location and is estimated for the July peak. Romanian prices are converted from RON using an approximate USD rate from general knowledge. FX: the 0.6955 observation (15 Oct 2026, 4 pm) was taken from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the RBA page itself was not opened directly. A third-party table lists 0.6947 for 16 Oct 2026, which is unverified and not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Eastern European capitals with similar tourism pricing (for example Sofia, Budapest and Warsaw), positioned below Western European capitals. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker for those items.
